# grammers-mtproto

`grammers-mtproto` implements Telegram's [Mobile Transport Protocol](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto). It creates, encrypts, decrypts, and parses protocol messages without performing network I/O.

This directory contains a narrowly patched copy of version 0.10.0 for use by `tgdl`. The patch scope, upstream revision, and maintenance requirements are documented in the [vendored patch overview](../README.md).
